title: Indefinite Causal Order Reverses the Real-Complex Hierarchy
summary: [Note added after submission. After posting the first version of this preprint and corresponding with Ved Kunte and Kuntal Sengupta, we identified an issue with the claimed separation between real quantum theory and ordinary complex quantum theory in the process-matrix framework. This version imposes normalization only for local CPTP maps acting on the parties' process input-output systems, which we call N1.
